description: nnU-Net-style 3D U-Net with a shared encoder, a pancreas decoder producing a probabilistic pancreas map, a tumor decoder conditioned on that map at multiple scales, and a lightweight Transformer bottleneck.

paper.title: PanGuide3D: Cohort-Robust Pancreas Tumor Segmentation via Probabilistic Pancreas Conditioning and a Transformer Bottleneck

trained_on: PanTS training split (7,200 train / 1,800 validation of 9,000 cases)

evaluation.protocol: five-fold cross-validation; each fold's checkpoint evaluated on both test sets

test_sets.pants: PanTS official test set, 901 cases, 151 tumor-positive (in-cohort)
test_sets.msd: MSD Task07 Pancreas, 57 cases, all tumor-positive (out-of-cohort)

ablations_and_baselines.TransBNeck: Transformer bottleneck, single decoder, no pancreas conditioning

subgroups_note: The paper analyses tumor Dice and sensitivity by tumor size and pancreatic subregion (Figure 7), but reports those only as a heatmap; no numeric values are tabulated, so none are recorded here.
